name: Morse.critCount
hypotheses: model space E finite-dimensional (more generally: the two indices agree at every critical point); f need not be Morse
difference: Inherited from the index: in infinite dimension the project's index is always 0. On M = E = ℓ²(ℕ), f x = ⟪x, x⟫ - 2x₀² has the single critical point 0, of project index 0 and blind index 1, so C₀ is 1 for the project and 0 for the blind definition.
why: Both count, with Set.ncard, the points with mfderiv = 0 and index k for the same preferred-chart Hessian, so they agree whenever the indices agree at critical points, in particular in finite dimension. The counterexample needs an infinite-dimensional model, outside the textbook; every project theorem about critCount assumes FiniteDimensional ℝ E.
